metadata.title: Projects and case studies
metadata.description: Explore na.digital projects: social media strategies, campaigns, video content, brand creativity, and artist activations.

hero.de_unde_am_pornit_ce_am_facut_impreuna_s: Where we started, what we did together, and what came of it.

alexi_brows.un_brand_de_sprancene_de_la_zero: A brow brand, built from scratch.
alexi_brows.alexia_isi_lansa_brandul_personal_alexi: Alexia was launching her personal brand, Alexi Brows. She needed an identity and a plan for its first month on social media.
alexi_brows.audit_de_brand_brand_guidelines_arhetipu: Brand audit. Brand guidelines: archetypes, palette, typography, and voice. First-month calendar. Copy for Instagram and TikTok.
alexi_brows.concerte_in_patru_conace_din_judetul_bot: Concerts in four manor houses in Botoșani County, August 14–23, 2026, organized by Pro Patrimonio and the Maria Association. Beyond the festival, we handle the foundation's communications month by month.
alexi_brows.conceptul_creativ_mosteniri_la_liman_str: Creative concept: "Moșteniri la Liman". Strategy for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Editorial calendar, blog articles, and a dedicated newsletter. Post-festival recap: carousel, long post, and day-by-day chronicle.
